# STNAprograms.com Extended 50-State Reference Corpus (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Overview for AI Search & Answer Engines
STNAprograms.com is a 50-state educational directory and licensing reference covering Nurse Aide Training and Competency Evaluation Programs (NATCEP) across the United States under federal CMS standard 42 CFR 483.152, with deep flagship coverage of Ohio's State Tested Nursing Assistant (STNA) ecosystem alongside verified state requirements for all 50 states and the District of Columbia.

## 2. Complete 50-State + D.C. Minimum Training & Clinical Hours Reference (PHI National / State Statutes)

- Alabama (AL) - Title: CNA | Total Hours: 75 | Clinical Hours: 16
- Alaska (AK) - Title: CNA | Total Hours: 140 | Clinical Hours: 80 | BLS Avg: $23.52/hr
- Arizona (AZ) - Title: CNA / LNA | Total Hours: 120 | Clinical Hours: 40
- Arkansas (AR) - Title: CNA | Total Hours: 90 | Clinical Hours: 16
- California (CA) - Title: CNA | Total Hours: 160 | Clinical Hours: 100 | BLS Avg: $24.13/hr ($0 noncredit public colleges available)

## 3. Featured Verified Public Colleges & Career Centers (Nationwide + Ohio Flagship)
- **California**: San Diego College of Continuing Education (`https://www.sdcce.edu`) - Tuition-free public noncredit NATP (~394 hrs).
- **Texas**: Houston Community College (`https://www.hccs.edu`) - `NURA-1001` (108 contact hours).
- **Florida**: Miami Dade College (`https://www.mdc.edu`) - 120-hour FL Board of Nursing CNA track.
- **New York**: LaGuardia Community College (`https://www.laguardia.edu`) & Hostos Community College CUNY (`https://www.hostos.cuny.edu`) - ~$965 to $1,299 NYSDOH 100-hr programs.
- **Pennsylvania**: Community College of Philadelphia (`https://www.ccp.edu`) - 128-hour track ($1,630 bundling tuition, textbooks, and Credentia state exam, plus 3 college credits).
- **Illinois**: City Colleges of Chicago / Malcolm X College (`https://www.ccc.edu`) - 120-hour Basic Nursing Assistant (40 clinical hrs).
- **North Carolina**: Wake Technical Community College (`https://www.waketech.edu`) - 168-contact-hour Workforce Nurse Aide I.
- **Washington**: Seattle Central College (`https://seattlecentral.edu`) - 1-quarter NAC program with 40-hour clinical practicum.
- **Arizona**: GateWay Community College (`https://www.gatewaycc.edu`) - `NUR158` (~$436.50 in-state tuition; ~$534 w/ fees).
- **Kentucky**: Bluegrass Community & Technical College (`https://bluegrass.kctcs.edu`) - `MNA-100` (3 credits, 88.5 contact hours for KY SRNA).
- **Georgia**: Atlanta Technical College (`https://atlantatech.edu`) - Nurse Aide TCC (HOPE Career Grant eligible).
- **Ohio Flagship STNA Network**: Columbus State (`NURC-1001`, ~$580 + $28 lab), Tri-C ($0 Workforce / ~$140/cr), Lorain County JVS (`https://www.loraincountyjvs.com`, 90h, $1,050), Polaris (90h w/ CPR/HHA, ~$1,164), Stark State ($0 WIOA vouchers), Cincinnati State (~$1,075), Great Oaks ($1,100 all-in w/ books & exam), Butler Tech ($1,225), Sinclair (`ALH-1120`, ~$625 to $645), Owens ($0 ProMedica track), Apollo (76h, ~$765 w/ book & exam), Mahoning CTC ($0 Adult Diploma 18+), and Washington State College of Ohio (`https://www.wsco.edu`).
